task.title: Skip stale queued wake events after task status changes
task.summary_zh: 修補 orchestrator queue 中已過期的 wake event，避免 task 狀態已變更後仍被舊 dispatch 喚醒。
acceptance: stale dispatcher events are skipped at delivery time
done or approved tasks are not launched from old queue entries
regression tests cover stale in_progress and stale review dispatches
task.next: Finalized BUS-VAL-004: supervisor process_queue now revalidates queued review/owner dispatch wake events against current task status and dispatch signature before launching a worker, so stale wake-ups are skipped after task status changes while current events still start normally. Verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s .orchestrator -p 'test_*.py' (36 tests OK).

handoffs.message: Added a stale dispatch guard in process_queue so queued dispatcher wake events are revalidated against current ai-status before worker launch; stale events are marked completed with wake_skipped instead of re-awakening changed or done tasks. Added regression tests for stale skip and current dispatch pass-through. Verified with python3 -m unittest discover -s .orchestrator -p 'test_*.py' and python3 -m py_compile .orchestrator/supervisor.py .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py.

Reviewer shifted from Gemini to Claude so tooling validation no longer depends on the unstable Gemini review lane. Review approved: The stale dispatch guard in process_queue correctly re-validates events against current status, and regression tests successfully verify the skipping of stale events and execution of current events.
